def _ridge(x, y, n, penalty):
    mu = x[:n].mean(axis=0)
    h = (x-mu)/np.maximum(x[:n].std(axis=0), 1e-8)
    ht = h[:n]
    center = y.mean(axis=0)
    coef = np.linalg.solve(ht.T@ht + penalty*np.eye(h.shape[1]), ht.T@(y-center))
    return h[n:]@coef + center
